Today and everyday, we say No Kings in America.

Here's what we must do next.

Video

Trump has launched us into an unpopular war, tanked the economy, and unleashed a masked army of thugs to terrorize communities all over the country.

Heather and I discuss why the Mad King’s actions makes today's No Kings 3 marches all the more important on this week’s Coffee Klatch.

piped.video/RlbaeBp0c4w

As we resist tyranny, America gains solidarity.

As we gain solidarity, we build courage.

As we feel courageous and stand up to Trump, we weaken him and his regime.

Let's continue to build solidarity by peacefully opposing our tyrant-in-chief today at No Kings protests across the country.

Donald Trump paused his wartime cabinet meeting for a critical discussion ... about Sharpies?

Video

Tomorrow, across America, we have another opportunity to make our opposition to the Trump regime visible, loud, and clear. Are you planning to join a No Kings protest where you live? robertreich.substack.com/p/o…

Was this insider trading?

Video

Yesterday, a young woman prevailed in a lawsuit against Meta and YouTube in which she accused them of designing their apps to be as addictive and harmful to kids as cigarettes. This is a big deal. But more needs to be done. robertreich.substack.com/p/h…
We need to talk about this... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

This No Kings Day on March 28 is more important than ever.

Find your local protest at nokings.org

Video

Flying already sucks.

It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages.

But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.

Video

So what will America have gotten out of Trump’s “excursion” in Iran? Zilch. Actually, less than zilch because in many ways we’re worse off than when it started. But that won't stop him from declaring "victory." Some thoughts... robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Nexstar and Tegna’s merger was just given a special green light by Trump’s FCC.

Never heard of these companies? Well, they could soon control your local news stations. Watch.

Video

Tyranny cannot succeed where people refuse to submit to it.

Next Saturday, on the third No Kings Day, we will proclaim our refusal to submit. 

We will reaffirm that America Belongs to us. Some thoughts...
robertreich.substack.com/p/s…

You might hear people say that protesting doesn’t make a difference.

Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares why that’s not true.

Video

Trump has no plan for his war on Iran.

He can’t even come up with a coherent justification for it.

Meanwhile, his economy is tanking and even some of his supporters are jumping ship.

Is this the week the tide turns on him for good? piped.video/VgiQmE71XuY

Yesterday, Trump said that he’d do whatever is necessary to ease the oil crisis. He also assured America that the crisis “will be over soon.” I'm calling bullshit. Here's why he's trapped in Iran.

robertreich.substack.com/p/p…

The average annual electric bill in the U.S. increased by $110 during Trump’s first year in office.

Remember when he promised to lower energy costs on the campaign trail?

That’s far from the only promise he’s broken.

piped.video/watch?v=AcefFTXU…

Trump repeatedly promised on the campaign trail to cap credit card interest rates at 10 percent.

But since he took office, Americans have paid nearly $240.7B in credit card interest — $134.5B more than what they would have paid under a 10 percent cap.

Like so many of his promises, it was another lie. piped.video/watch?v=vZwV58Dd…

When 3.5% of a population actively participates in sustained, peaceful protest, it can topple authoritarian regimes — like the one currently in the Oval Office.

We need 12 million people to show up on March 28 to get to 3.5%. Will you be one of them?

Find out how at nokings.org

The grasshopper gets it — divide and conquer. Today's oligarchs use the same playbook. But together, we have all the power. Watch.

"We can have democracy in this country, or we can have great wealth concentrated in the hands of a few, but we can't have both." 

–Justice Louis Brandeis

Today and everyday, we say No Kings in America.

Here's what we must do next.

Trump has launched us into an unpopular war, tanked the economy, and unleashed a masked army of thugs to terrorize communities all over the country.

Heather and I discuss why the Mad King’s actions makes today's No Kings 3 marches all the more important on this week’s Coffee Klatch.

As we resist tyranny, America gains solidarity.

As we gain solidarity, we build courage.

As we feel courageous and stand up to Trump, we weaken him and his regime.

Let's continue to build solidarity by peacefully opposing our tyrant-in-chief today at No Kings protests across the country.
"Call it democracy, or call it democratic socialism, but there must be a better distribution of wealth within this country for all God's children." —MLK Jr.

CPAC CROWD: *cheers*

SCHLAPP: No. That was the wrong answer.

Donald Trump paused his wartime cabinet meeting for a critical discussion ... about Sharpies?

"Elon Musk participated in a phone call on Tuesday with President Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, an unusual appearance by a private citizen on a call between two heads of state during a wartime crisis."

1/2 This memo identifies absolutely no source of legal authority for paying TSA. It does not point to an appropriation that is available for this purpose, nor does it point to any legal authority to transfer some other appropriation to TSA. www.whitehouse.gov/presidential...

Previous No Kings protests have clearly gotten under the skin of the tyrant in the White House.

But protesting him isn’t enough. How do we turn the momentum into action?

Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares some thoughts. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cn4CSqH3YoA
https://www.nokings.org/

Communities are taking on Big Tech — and winning.

Nearly 50 different data center projects totaling $156 billion were blocked or stalled thanks to local opposition last year.

Some of these projects were set to receive taxpayer funding.

Never doubt the power of organizing with your neighbors.

We must not lose sight of this lawlessness. Trump is unilaterally acting as judge, jury, and executioner. This is murder — and it is a danger to us all.

www.nytimes.com/2026/03/24/w...

Donald Trump, Jr.'s VC firm invested in a startup that produces rare-earth magnets for military equipment.

Months later, the Pentagon awarded the company a $620M loan.

Remember that Don Jr. also has a stake in a drone company that recently received defense contracts.

Coincidence? Or corruption?
